verses.text: We sent it[1] down on the Night of Determination.
But what can make you sg realize what the Night of Determination is?
The Night of Determination is better than a thousand months—
in it descend the angels, with the Spirit[2] among them, by the leave of their Lord with every command.
Peace! It is until the rise [3] of dawn.

footnotes.3: Qira’at: Al-Kesa’i and Khalaf read it as: “…until the point of the rise of dawn.”
